why_zh: 官方asyncio任务文档：Task、TaskGroup、timeout、取消与shield，是并发上限和取消清理的API真值。
why_en: Official asyncio task reference: Task, TaskGroup, timeouts, cancellation and shield; the API source of truth for bounded concurrency and cleanup.

title: Problem Solving with Algorithms and Data Structures using Python
why_zh: 免费在线教材，用Python讲复杂度、排序查找、哈希、栈队列、树与图；限时刷题前先补齐概念。
why_en: Free online textbook covering complexity, sorting/searching, hashing, stacks/queues, trees and graphs in Python; build the concepts before timed practice.

title: System Design Primer
why_zh: 高星免费系统设计教材：缓存模式、异步队列、背压、一致性与可用性取舍，也是系统设计面试的公共底稿。
why_en: Widely used free system-design guide: cache patterns, asynchronous queues, back pressure and consistency/availability tradeoffs; also a common base for design interviews.

title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
why_zh: OWASP维护的安全实践清单；认证、授权、会话、JWT、密钥管理与SSRF防护各有独立条目。
why_en: OWASP-maintained practice sheets with separate entries for authentication, authorization, sessions, JWT, secrets management and SSRF prevention.

title: OpenIntro Statistics
why_zh: 免费开放统计教材：抽样、置信区间、假设检验、功效与配对数据，覆盖实验判断所需的统计基础。
why_en: Free open statistics textbook: sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, power and paired data for experimental judgment.

title: LiteLLM Documentation
why_zh: 多provider统一调用层的维护者文档；读异常映射、重试/fallback、超时、streaming与用量记录，借鉴adapter设计，不必引入全部功能。
why_en: Maintainer docs for a multi-provider client layer; study exception mapping, retries/fallbacks, timeouts, streaming and usage tracking as adapter design without adopting every feature.
cost: free docs; provider calls are billed

title: Anthropic: Interactive Prompt Engineering Tutorial
why_zh: Anthropic官方9章交互教程：清晰指令、角色、示例、结构化分隔、预填与链式提示、减少幻觉，每章有练习。
why_en: Anthropic’s official nine-chapter interactive tutorial: clear instructions, roles, examples, structured delimiters, prefilling and chaining, and reducing hallucination, with exercises.
cost: read-free; exercises use a billed API

title: RouteLLM
why_zh: LMSYS开源路由框架与论文；按难度在强/弱模型间分流，并用质量—成本曲线和阈值评估路由收益。
why_en: LMSYS routing framework and paper; routes between strong and weak models by difficulty and evaluates gains with quality/cost curves and thresholds.
cost: free software; model calls are billed

title: Docling Documentation
why_zh: 开源文档解析工具：PDF/Office/HTML、版面、表格、OCR与结构化切块；用来理解解析质量如何影响检索。
why_en: Open-source document conversion: PDF/Office/HTML, layout, tables, OCR and structure-aware chunking; shows how parsing quality affects retrieval.

title: MinerU
why_zh: 中文场景常用的PDF解析开源项目；对照公式、表格、版面和中文OCR的解析效果。
why_en: Open-source PDF parser common in Chinese deployments; compare formulas, tables, layout and Chinese OCR quality.
cost: free software; local or GPU resources

title: LangChain: RAG From Scratch
why_zh: 免费notebook与视频系列：multi-query、RAG-Fusion、问题分解、HyDE、路由、RAPTOR、ColBERT与自纠正RAG，逐个实现。
why_en: Free notebook and video series implementing multi-query, RAG-Fusion, decomposition, HyDE, routing, RAPTOR, ColBERT and corrective RAG one by one.

title: ALCE: Enabling LLMs to Generate Text with Citations
why_zh: 引用生成的基准论文；定义引用召回/精确率，区分回答正确、证据支持与引用正确。
why_en: Benchmark paper for cited generation; defines citation recall/precision and separates answer correctness, evidential support and citation quality.

title: Microsoft GraphRAG
why_zh: GraphRAG维护者文档：实体/关系抽取、社区摘要、global/local search与索引成本；先证明图结构优于文档检索。
why_en: Maintainer docs for entity/relation extraction, community summaries, global/local search and indexing cost; prove that graph structure beats document retrieval first.
cost: free software; indexing uses billed models

title: Anthropic: Equipping Agents with Agent Skills
why_zh: Skills设计原文：SKILL.md、渐进加载、脚本与资源打包，以及技能与工具/MCP的分工。
why_en: Design write-up for SKILL.md, progressive disclosure, bundled scripts/resources and how skills relate to tools and MCP.

title: Agent Skills Specification
why_zh: Agent Skills开放标准；字段、目录结构与兼容客户端以规范为准。
why_en: Open Agent Skills standard; fields, directory layout and client compatibility follow the specification.

title: Anthropic: Writing Effective Tools for Agents
why_zh: 工具设计工程文章：选择该做的工具、命名空间、返回有意义的上下文、控制token与错误信息，并用评测迭代工具描述。
why_en: Engineering article on choosing tools, namespacing, returning meaningful context, token-efficient responses and error messages, and evaluating tool descriptions.

title: Adding Error Bars to Evals
why_zh: Anthropic的评测统计论文：标准误、聚类题目、配对差异与功效分析，直接对应模型/系统对比。
why_en: Anthropic’s statistics paper for evals: standard errors, clustered questions, paired differences and power analysis for model/system comparisons.

title: RLHF Book (Nathan Lambert)
why_zh: 免费在线RLHF教材：偏好数据、奖励模型、DPO等直接对齐算法、PPO/GRPO与可验证奖励，概念与公式连贯。
why_en: Free online RLHF textbook: preference data, reward models, direct alignment such as DPO, PPO/GRPO and verifiable rewards with consistent notation.

title: Google PAIR: People + AI Guidebook
why_zh: Google PAIR的人机交互设计指南：心智模型、可解释与信任、反馈与控制、错误与优雅失败。
why_en: Google PAIR design guide: mental models, explainability and trust, feedback and control, errors and graceful failure.

title: What We’ve Learned From A Year of Building with LLMs
why_zh: 多位一线从业者合写的LLM产品经验；战术、运营、战略三部分覆盖评测、版本固定、成本与团队分工。
why_en: Practitioner-written lessons on LLM products; tactical, operational and strategic sections cover evaluation, version pinning, cost and team roles.

title: Tech Interview Handbook
why_zh: 免费求职全流程手册：简历、准备计划、编程面试、行为面试与谈薪。
why_en: Free end-to-end job-search handbook: résumé, study plans, coding and behavioral interviews and negotiation.

title: Chip Huyen: Introduction to Machine Learning Interviews

why_en: Free online interview book: ML role types and hiring process plus math, CS and ML-workflow question banks; supplement LLM topics from units 04–07.

title: Design Docs at Google
why_zh: 设计文档的结构、目标/非目标、备选方案与评审方式；用于项目答辩与入职后的方案沟通。
why_en: Structure of design documents (goals/non-goals, alternatives and review) for project defenses and design communication at work.

title: Jason Liu: Systematically Improving Your RAG
why_zh: RAG持续改进方法：合成问题建基线、检索指标、按查询分群、用户反馈与专项优化。

why_zh: Coding Agent官方实践指南：先探索再计划、上下文文件、权限与验证循环；方法可迁移到其他编码助手。
why_en: Official coding-agent practice guide: explore before planning, context files, permissions and verification loops; the methods transfer to other assistants.

title: AGENTS.md
why_zh: 跨工具的仓库级Agent指令格式；说明构建、测试与约定写在哪里。
why_en: Cross-tool format for repository-level agent instructions: where to put build, test and convention guidance.

title: Vercel AI SDK
why_zh: TypeScript的模型调用与流式UI工具包；读streaming、工具调用渲染与生成式UI。

why_en: Official guide to provider-side prefix caching: eligibility, prefix layout, hit observability and billing; compare other vendors’ mechanisms in their docs.

why_en: Common managed model platform in North America: model catalog, quotas, VPC/data boundaries and guardrail services.
cost: free docs; usage billed by AWS

why_zh: 直接对页面图像做多向量检索的论文与ViDoRe基准；对照OCR+文本管线。

cost: free software; self-host or managed costs

why_zh: 开源低代码LLM应用平台的维护者文档：工作流、知识库、工具/插件与自部署；注意其自定义许可证。

title: Coze (扣子) Documentation
why_zh: 字节跳动的Agent搭建平台文档；对照工作流、插件与发布渠道。

cost: free docs; platform usage may be billed

title: n8n Documentation
why_zh: 工作流自动化平台，常用于把LLM节点接入业务系统；对照触发器、凭据与错误处理。

why_zh: 提出六种可落地的防注入设计模式并配十个案例，讨论安全与效用的取舍。

title: Simon Willison: The Lethal Trifecta for AI Agents

title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026)
why_zh: OWASP针对Agent应用的十大风险：目标劫持、工具滥用、身份与权限滥用、记忆与上下文投毒等。
why_en: OWASP’s top risks for agentic applications, including goal hijacking, tool misuse, identity and privilege abuse, and memory/context poisoning.

why_zh: 让judge与领域专家对齐：二元判断、带理由的标注与一致率迭代。
